cases.title: Scenario list covers every Base × Rank combination
cases.preconditions: A completed optimisation run (or set of runs) whose scope is intended to cover all F8 crew bases.
cases.steps:
1. Open the Scenario list and note every scenario (and, within a scenario, every base group) that produced a roster.
2. Tick each base off this list: YVR, YEG, YYZ, YYC, YXX, YWG, YHZ, YKF, YUL, YOW.
3. For each base, confirm the pilot ranks CA + FO are represented, and — where that base has cabin crew — the cabin ranks IFD + FA.
4. Note any base that has NO cabin crew based there; cabin rows for that base are expected to be empty (N/A), not a coverage gap.
cases.expected: Every base above appears in the roster output. Pilot ranks (CA, FO) are covered at all bases; cabin ranks (IFD, FA) are covered at all bases that have cabin crew based there. A base with no cabin crew shows no IFD/FA rows and this is recorded as N/A, not a failure.

cases.title: YVR (Vancouver) — pilot roster quality (CA / FO)
cases.preconditions: A completed scenario covering YVR pilot flying.
cases.steps:
1. Open the roster output for YVR pilots (CA and FO).
2. Coverage: check the Uncovered tab shows no uncovered YVR pilot pairings/flights.
3. Seniority: spot-check that at YVR more-senior CA/FO received the more-preferred assignments ahead of junior crew.
4. Bids: confirm honoured YVR pilot bids (pairing / days-off / reserve) match what the crew requested.
5. Credit: check the Credit Hours tab — YVR pilots sit within the target band with no extreme outliers.
cases.expected: YVR pilot roster is fully covered (0 uncovered), seniority order is respected, honoured bids match requests, and credit hours are balanced within target for both CA and FO.

cases.title: YVR (Vancouver) — cabin roster quality (IFD / FA)
cases.preconditions: A completed scenario covering YVR cabin flying. NOTE: if YVR has no cabin crew based there, mark this case N/A.
cases.steps:
1. If YVR is a pilots-only base, mark N/A and stop.
2. Open the roster output for YVR cabin crew (IFD and FA).
3. Coverage: check the Uncovered tab shows no uncovered YVR cabin positions.
4. Seniority: spot-check senior IFD/FA received preferred assignments ahead of junior crew.
5. Bids: confirm honoured YVR cabin bids match requests.
6. Credit: check YVR cabin credit hours are balanced within target.
cases.expected: For a base with cabin crew: YVR cabin roster is fully covered, seniority respected, honoured bids match requests, and IFD/FA credit hours are balanced. For a pilots-only base: case is marked N/A with no IFD/FA rows expected.
